assertions.assertion: CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, was not medically necessary
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a known history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with underlying arrhythmias and assess for ischemic changes in the context of established coronary artery disease
The submitted diagnosis codes are I25.10 and R00.2
The CO-50 adjustment applies to this encounter
